covered.detail: 436 English National Rail stations left without a home by UK station fill phase 2a's fifteen named regions, from the UK's national real-time feed.

stations: 436 stations: every Darwin-verified English National Rail station with no home region as of UK station fill phase 2a (14 Sep 2026 UK station fill, phase 2b).
notes: This is an internal catch-all region, not a place a rider picks by name — the country-wide station picker searches across every region including this one.
